new.analysis: The athlete is in week two of a recovery walk‑run program, returning from a stress reaction in the left shin. Three 15‑minute sessions total 45 minutes of moving time were completed with no pain. The plan should stay in the same low‑effort zone, increase total running time by no more than about 10 % this week, and keep each session easy. Increasing each walk‑run to 16 minutes adds roughly 3 minutes total, comfortably within the 10 % rule. Rest days remain, and we keep the physio regimen. The key watch points are shin pain, heart‑rate drift, progression, rest quality, and consistency with the rehab exercises. No red flags emerge, so no safety callouts are needed.
